method.aggregate: median of the six process medians for each version; each process median uses seven timing blocks
method.paired_range: minimum and maximum of six paired time reductions; descriptive, not a confidence interval
method.scope: Warm offline calls. No process startup or disk output in timed operations. SVG cases include a fresh drawer, with subjects/ChartData prepared outside the timer. Pipeline includes subject, ChartData, drawer and SVG.
